subject: Renewal handshake: new-term onramp & capacity alignment
messages:
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Silva <ana@novohealth.com>, Tom Rivers <tom.r@novotech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2024-11-12T16:18:00-08:00
Subject: Renewal handshake: new-term onramp & capacity alignment

Hi Ana / Tom —

Thanks again for the conversation last week. Per our renewal timeline, we wanted to start a short kickoff to capture the updated term, expected throughput for the next 12 months, and lock a QBR slot to align execs and ops. TL;DR: proposed 30-day onramp after signature, target go-live by 2024-12-15, and a QBR the week of 11/18 to confirm staffing and runbooks.

Proposed agenda for our kickoff QBR:
- 15m: Introductions & goals for the renewal period
- 20m: Capacity forecast & traffic profile (we'll share estimated p50/p95 token throughput)
- 15m: Term/contract changes & billing cadence (Ana, legal note)
- 10m: Ops/CS runbook & escalation path
- 10m: Next steps and owners

Please pick one preferred slot next week (all times PST):
- Tue 11/19 10:00–10:45
- Wed 11/20 14:00–14:45
- Thu 11/21 09:00–09:45

Attachments: SOW draft v2 (scope & pricing), capacity forecast CSV, and a short SLA summary image.

Ask: please confirm preferred QBR slot and whether you want the billing term to shift to annual prepay or remain monthly commits (if you want to propose a change here, flag it so we can loop in finance/legal).

Internal notes to Ben/Kim/Marissa: Ben — can you pull the last 90-day token profile + p95 latency data and add to the capacity CSV? Kim — legal will need the term change language if Ana wants annual prepay. Marissa — can you prepare a brief staffing ramp slide for the QBR?

Thanks — aiming to keep this short and action-focused.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi | Sr. Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
From: Ana Silva <ana@novohealth.com>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
Cc: Tom Rivers <tom.r@novotech.com>, Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>
Date: 2024-11-13T08:07:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal handshake: new-term onramp & capacity alignment

Thanks Irene — appreciate the clear agenda. We can do the QBR next week; Wed 11/20 14:00 PST works best for our team.

A couple of items up front:
1) Term: We'd like to discuss switching to an annual prepay at the new tier if the unit price can be adjusted — finance needs a rough delta to evaluate.
2) Throughput: Our platform spikes for billing-close windows. Can you confirm expected p95 tokens/sec for the recommended commit (we currently see ~1.8k tokens/sec peak, and we'd target headroom to 3k)?
3) Contract: Tom will be our procurement lead; he prefers to see a redline-ready SOW in advance of the QBR.

I'll review the attachments and confirm any edits. If you need a contact from engineering for the throughput questions, loop in Tom or I can add our infra lead.

—Ana Silva
Head of Platform, NovoHealth
From: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>
To: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Ana Silva <ana@novohealth.com>
Cc: Tom Rivers <tom.r@novotech.com>
Date: 2024-11-13T11:22:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal handshake: new-term onramp & capacity alignment

Great — Wed 11/20 14:00 PST confirmed. I'll own the throughput estimates. Quick plan and owners: 
- Ben: generate p50/p95 tokens/sec and projected 3, 6, 12 month commit table + headroom scenarios (will attach updated capacity_forecast_q4.csv). Due: 11/15 EOD.
- Kimberly: draft term amendment language for annual prepay vs monthly commits and a short cost-delta summary for finance. Due: 11/15 COB (legal review overlay).
- Marissa: staffing & ops runbook slide + recommend on-call rotation. Due: 11/18 EOD.
- Irene: send calendar invite and SOW redline v3 once Kim confirms language.

Ana — for throughput calc I'll use your 1.8k peak and produce a recommended commit at three headroom tiers (1.5x / 2x / 3x). If you can share the infra contact, I'll copy them on the updated CSV.

Attachments: capacity_forecast_q4.csv (updated in next email).

Ben
Ben Carter | Enterprise Solutions | Redwood Inference
From: Irene Choi <irene@redwood.ai>
To: Ana Silva <ana@novohealth.com>, Tom Rivers <tom.r@novotech.com>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben@redwood.ai>, Kimberly Park <kimberly@redwood.ai>, Marissa Cole <marissa@redwood.ai>
Date: 2024-11-14T09:02:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Renewal handshake: new-term onramp & capacity alignment

Thanks everyone — calendar invite sent (link below) for Wed 11/20 14:00–14:45 PST. I also attached SOW_draft_v3 that integrates the scope clarifications we discussed; Kimberly and I will circulate a redline before close of day 11/15.

Calendar: https://calendar.redwood.ai/event/7a1b2c3d
SOW: NovoHealth_SOW_draft_v3.pdf (attached to calendar invite)

Immediate next steps (quick):
- Ben: throughput table & updated CSV by 11/15 EOD
- Kimberly: term amendment + redline by 11/15 COB
- Marissa: staffing slide by 11/18 EOD
- Ana/Tom: confirm if you want us to route billing to annual prepay for a pricing delta or stay monthly commits — reply in-thread if possible.

If anything else pops up, flag it here. Looking forward to the sync — we'll keep it tight and exec-facing.

Best,
Irene
Irene Choi | Sr. Enterprise AE | Redwood Inference
Attachments: NovoHealth_SOW_draft_v3.pdf, capacity_forecast_q4_v2.csv
